articles.title: OKX, MetaMask, Matter Labs back dispute resolution court for AI agents
articles.snippet: The Genlayer Foundation is leading the 27-firm consortium that makes AI-based payments, escrow and dispute resolution interoperable.

articles.title: UK politicians mull permanent crypto donation ban in wake of Nigel Farage scandal
articles.snippet: Labour lawmakers proposed a full moratorium on crypto donations in March, which some have sought be made permanent after millions of dollars in contributions were linked to Reform leader Nigel Farage.

articles.title: Labour MPs Push to Make UK Crypto Donation Ban Permanent
articles.snippet: The lawmakers have tabled amendments to make the current moratorium permanent, as the fallout over Reform UK's funding widens.
